# MilePost Zero: Theodore - Ammo Merchant

__Name__

Theodore

__Role__

Ammo Merchant

__Location__

After being hired: From Marley’s desk, face north and follow the tunnel all the way to the end. Theo can be found either sitting at the bar at the end of the tunnel or in his workshop, on a workbench to the right of the bar.

__Cost__

Hire Cost (Tier 1) - 150 Supplies

Upgrade 1 (Tier 2) - 250 Supplies

Upgrade 2 (Tier 3) - 250 Supplies - **Cut from Live Servers**

__Notes__

You’ll need to finish the Skyline Valley Vault 63 Questline before starting Theodore’s quest, as the required areas and buildings will stay locked until you do. After completing the "Unconventional Weaponry" quest, Theo will automatically be upgraded to Tier 3 without needing any additional supplies.

__Snow Globe__

Yes

__Daily Quest__

No

__Vendor__

Yes

__Inventory__

**Tier 1**

- 308 rounds
- 38 rounds
- 44 rounds
- 45 rounds
- 50 Caliber Ball
- 50 Cal
- 10mm
- 5.56 rounds
- 5mm
- Arrows
- Cannonballs
- Crossbow Bolts
- Flares
- Shotgun Shells
- Railway Spikes

**Tier 2**

**Note: When speaking to Theo to start the quest, do not have the V63 Laser Carbine in your inventory. If you do, the quest will auto-complete, and you won’t learn the plan to craft the weapon. If you already have a V63 Laser Carbine, store it in your stash box until the quest is finished.**

- Unlocks the quest "Unconventional Weaponry" for the V63 laser weapon plan.

**Tier 3**

Tradeable

Will continue showing in Theodore's inventory once learned.

- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Standard Stock
- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Cyclic Capacitor
- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Insulated Capacitor
- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Overclocked Capacitor
- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Quick-Eject Capacitor
- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Extended Capacitor
- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Stabilized Stock
- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Forceful Stock
- Plan: V63 Laser Carbine Bruising Stock

__SPECIAL Checks__

Perception 4 check

Charisma 4 check

__Unconventional Weaponry Quest__

Rewards: V63 Laser Carbine Plan

After reaching Tier 2 with Theodore, initiate a conversation with him. Continue interacting with him through several dialogues until he eventually provides you with the quest.
